Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
This has reference to our intimation dated 6th August, 2026 regarding schedule of conference call with 
Analysts/Institutional Investors and pursuant to Regulation 30 read with sub-para 15(b)(i) of Para A of Part 
A Schedule III of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations 2015, the audio 
recording of conference call with Analysts/Institutional Investors held on 12th August, 2026 at 17:00 Hrs.

https://gfl.co.in/upload/pages/10046392.mp3.  
 
You are requested to take the same on record. 
 
Thanking you,
